text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: service=runtime-latency threshold=95p > 1200ms (fired)
alex: seeing the page. grabbing it — checking dashboards
maria: I also got it, but metrics look like a very short spike on the edge router
dan: any customer-facing errors? do we have any 5xx traffic correlated?
alex: not seeing increased 5xx. only latency SLO breach. traces show a handful of requests with long wait on kv-cache populate
maria: looks like kv-warmup batch spike. timeline: 3524688990 -> 3524689008 spike then auto-resolve
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alert auto-resolved after 42s (fired -> resolved)
alex: hmm auto-resolved but PD still created an incident. can we silence duplicates for warmup patterns?
maria: agree, but we should still triage briefly — could be symptomatic of coldstart cascading
oncall-shift-lead: tagging @dan for quick customer-impact check, then we can close
dan: checked logs for top-5 affected customers — no error rate bump. a few slower responses for heavy payloads, but no retries from clients
alex: attaching quick snippet from router logs (scrubbed):
```
[3524689002] request_id=abc123 model=redwood-XL latency_ms=1345 kv_warmup=true
[3524689003] request_id=def456 model=redwood-XL latency_ms=1289 kv_warmup=true
```
maria: config note: recent rollout adjusted `kv_prefill.enabled=false` on a subset of pods — might be related
oncall-shift-lead: who is taking follow-up to check rollout subset+metrics correlation? not blocking customers now but want fix
alex: I can run a narrow query on rollout tagging and correlate 5m windows
maria: I'll check autoscaler logs and any concurrent restarts
dan: ETA for shallow follow-up? try to have PR or rollback plan in next 2h if correlated
alex: running query now, will post results
incident-bot: Incidentbot: page acknowledged by alex
alex: acked. will monitor for recurrence for 15m then handoff if stable
maria: quick check: autoscaler didn't change desired pod count during spike window
alex: query results: 99% of spike traces originate from nodes with rollout-tag `kv-opt-out=v2`, ~18 requests total. not customer impacting beyond latency brief
dan: ok that's actionable. maria -> if autoscaler clear, we should re-enable prefill for that subset or revert rollout flag
maria: agree. creating a short ticket: "kv-prefill flag causing transient latency spikes on subset" and assigning to runtime-team
oncall-shift-lead: thanks. since PD incident auto-resolved and no customer impact, I'll add incident note and close thread after follow-up task created
alex: adding note with log pointers and trace ids
incident-bot: Incidentbot: follow-up task created: INC-3524689 (internal)
alex: handing off to evening oncall in 20m — ping me if it flares back
maria: will PR revert flag tomorrow morning if we see any re-occurrence
dan: marking severity low / no-customer-impact
oncall-shift-lead: closing loop here — if it reappears, escalate and reopen PD. :thumbsup:
